body:
Closes #843.

## Reproduction

Before this change, any non-offline unknown prompt caused `record_external_search` to emit an `example.org` URL, the Unix epoch, a prompt-derived hash, and a cache hit even though no retrieval or cache entry existed.

## What changed

- Removed fabricated `source:http` and `cache_hit` events. An unexecuted lookup now emits `policy:no_fetch_capability`.
- Added an opt-in, SHA-256-verified source capture boundary. It stores exact response bytes and retrieval metadata, defaults to cache-only operation, honors TTL for explicitly enabled live refreshes, and rejects corrupted replay data.
- Routed explicit HTTP fetches through the boundary. `FORMAL_AI_LIVE_FETCH=1` is required for network fallback; `FORMAL_AI_SOURCE_CACHE_DIR` selects the cache root.
- Preserved bundled curated-project summaries as local seed evidence; they remain available offline without claiming an external retrieval.
- Added a real DuckDuckGo Instant Answer execution path whose returned rankings feed the existing reciprocal-rank-fusion implementation.
- Connected exact captures to option observation, statement verification, and statement-audit evidence. Statement verification still requires explicit content classification—a successful fetch alone is not supporting evidence.
- Removed the old fabricated-trail assertions and pruned their hardcoded-language allowlist entries.

## Verification

- `cargo test --test unit issue_843 -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test --test unit source_cache -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test --test unit self_ast_census -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test --test unit total_closure::seed_has_total_reference_closure -- --nocapture`
- `sh src/web/wasm-worker/build.sh`
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `GITHUB_BASE_REF=main npm run --prefix tests/e2e check:language-test-coverage`
- `rust-script scripts/check-file-size.rs`
- `rust-script scripts/check-hardcoded-language.rs`
- `cargo test self_coding_session_replays`
- Serial reruns of every integration group that hit local parallel socket exhaustion: issue 624, issue 680, issue 712, and logging proxy—all passed.

The new fixture tests prove exact-byte cache replay, SHA-256 over retrieved bytes, truthful live/cache state, no transport attempt on an offline miss, real provider rankings entering RRF, and fetched content reaching all requested consumers. No live network is used in tests.

## Full-suite note

The parallel all-features run completed 174 integration tests and hit `EAGAIN` (`Resource temporarily unavailable`) in 14 loopback-server tests at `tests/integration/http_server.rs:131` or the equivalent logging-proxy POST. Each affected group passes with `--test-threads=1`, including all ten issue-680 tests, all six issue-712 tests, all logging-proxy tests, and the issue-624 test.

## Self-coding workflow

The repository’s local Formal AI → Agent CLI self-coding replay passed and `self_coding_session_replays` passed. The required `--live` wrapper was also attempted, but the external `solve` 2.9.0 model registry rejects its hardcoded `formal-ai` model before Agent CLI startup.

The fix itself is manually authored and intentionally has no self-authorship trailers. To satisfy the repository’s differential self-hosting ratchet without misattribution, a separate real Formal AI Agent CLI session (`ses_0685492f0ffe7g6o6kEqUywNeb`) generated a deterministic whole-repository source→links→source projection: 294 owned modules and 2,078 projection lines, with the transcript and server trace committed under `docs/case-studies/issue-843/self-hosting-evidence/`. The exact CI ratchet command passes locally.
title: Replace fabricated evidence with deterministic cached source captures
